fusions.name: Soaring Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds through the air up to 7 tiles onto the target and butts it for 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Skyfall Landing
fusions.desc: Leaps and lands where you stood, dealing 28 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Riding the Thermal
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Featherweight Tread
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
